name: Felix Haidopair
original_name: フェリクス・ハイドパイル
source: A hero who defeated [url=/c44905]Akbar[/url] in the previous war and saved Cranvar. After the war, Felix was able to take up a high position, but he chose to rebuild as the lord of his hometown, Haidopair, overrun by the Balanrain army. Felix is married to [url=/c96499]Lilfynia[/url], who fought with him in the war, but they have no children.
